extras.name: Denver
extras.note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the South Platte and the Front Range carry the fit; the 1908 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool, drawn from the north (the Twenty-Third Street Viaduct, ~1.3 km north of the point) looking south - the grid dense and legible to the southern suburbs, the Front Range along the southern horizon, a printed landmark index - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

extras.name: St. Paul
extras.note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the Minnesota and Mississippi rivers carry the fit; the 1906 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool, drawn from a high vantage on the east (the Minnesota side) looking west - the river confluence at the bottom of the sheet, the dense downtown grid centre-right on the Mississippi's west bank, the farmland horizon across the top (the west) - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

extras.name: Minneapolis
extras.note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid and the Mississippi carry the fit; the 1885 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool (the built-up city fills the whole frame, no horizon band), drawn from a high vantage on the south/southwest of the city (the west bank, below the downtown) - the sheet faces ~NNW: the Mississippi enters upper-left (the rapids below the falls, the long arch viaduct and its weir) and runs to the lower-right toward the confluence (off-sheet past the bottom edge); the dense west-bank downtown core sits upper-left of the 3rd Street suspension bridge (the two-tower masonry span at the sheet's mid-right), the brickyard and the river's downstream bend fill the lower right - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)

extras.name: Cleveland
extras.note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the Cuyahoga and the Lake Erie shoreline carry the fit; the 1877 staged sheet is the steepest (near-vertical) whole-city view in the pool, drawn from a high vantage over Lake Erie (south of the city) looking north - the Cuyahoga meanders in from the upper centre to its mouth centre-right (the Washington Avenue arch viaduct and a truss bridge over it, the Union Passenger Dock west of the mouth), the dense downtown core (Public Square with its fountain) at the sheet's centre just left of the mouth, the rotated grid legible to the farmland horizon, the lake with its ship traffic along the bottom - spanning the whole city beyond the 2000 m town box, so its fit is likely to end a review item (the 236a NY-1811 / DC-ring precedent)
